items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Yeah, we had Eddie Pearson. Eddie Pearson, Nelson. Those were outstanding people for me.

ctx.x: He still got a little bit left on the tape. And trombone players, they haven't he got trombone players?

Yeah, we had Eddie Pearson. Eddie Pearson, Nelson. Those were outstanding people for me. Jim was always a good trombone player. Jim Robson was always a good trombone player. You know where you take him? Faking or reading? He always was a great man. What about piano players? Piano players? We had Louis Given. You ever heard of him? I knew him. Alegrat Alexander. You ever heard of him?
Heard of him. Talked to him on the phone. I never had met him.
